faqs.question: Which paper bag should I choose for bread or pastries?
faqs.answer: Start with the filled product. Long baguettes need a suitable length and opening; wider loaves may need side gussets. For pastries, compare flat or square-bottom bags and specify any grease barrier. A handled carrier can hold wrapped items or a bakery box. Review fit and packing conditions in a sample.

faqs.question: Can you supply custom printed bread bags wholesale?
faqs.answer: Yes. VPN makes bags to the agreed size, paper and artwork in Vietnam. Share your logo, print colors and quantity for each design. We provide design support and review the printed sample before production. For repeat supply, include your expected usage and preferred delivery batches.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: The general MOQ is 1,000 bags. The quotation confirms the minimum for your combination of size, paper, printing and artwork. For a larger order, send the quantity per design and size rather than only a combined total.

faqs.question: Can I order bread bags with a clear window?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our collection includes paper bread bags with a window. Specify the window position and size alongside the loaf dimensions and printed design. The window material, food-contact conditions and any ventilation requirements must be agreed for the order.

faqs.question: Are brown kraft bags automatically greaseproof or suitable for direct food contact?
faqs.answer: No. Paper color does not establish grease resistance or food-contact suitability. Tell us the food type, contact time, packing temperature and destination. The paper, ink, adhesive and any liner or window need to be specified for that use; request the relevant material documents before approval.

faqs.question: Can these bags be used for warm bread?
faqs.answer: The answer depends on the bag construction and packing conditions. Share the bread temperature, cooling process, closure and expected time in the bag. Check condensation, texture and appearance with your own product in a trial; a window or a kraft finish alone does not establish suitability.

faqs.question: How much do samples cost, and how long does production take?
faqs.answer: Sample fees depend on the design. Custom samples take 7–15 days depending on the order. Orders over 5,000 pieces qualify for a refund of 50% of the sample fee. Production takes 7–45 days after sample approval, depending on the order; shipping time is separate.

faqs.question: How are orders checked, packed and delivered internationally?
faqs.answer: Quality is checked at each production stage against the approved specification. Finished bags can be packed in cartons or shrink-wrapped bundles as agreed. Send your delivery country, city or postal code and receiving date so packing, transport and delivery terms can be reviewed in the quotation.
